name: test_cycle_progress
description: Deterministic test_cycle decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

reports.description: The fix-history array accumulated so far; this attempt's entry is appended to it. Defaults to empty when absent or not a list.

report.description: test_repair_record's report for this attempt, folded into the appended history entry.

persisted.description: Whether this attempt advanced the candidate; echoed as candidateAdvanced.

candidateAfter.description: Used as verifiedCandidate when the verification result carries no candidateCommit.

verification.description: This attempt's verification result, merged into the appended history entry.

runs.description: Prior run count; incremented by one for the new runCount. Defaults to 1 (i.e. yields runCount 2) when absent or not numeric.

reports.description: The fix history with this attempt's entry appended.

candidateAdvanced.description: True only when report.persisted is exactly true.
